definitions.gloss: advanced; leading; ahead of others in development or progress
definitions.explanation: Describes being at the forefront of development, technology, or civilization. Most commonly used as a modifier in compounds like 'advanced nation' or 'leading technology.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{減速|げんそく}→減速：13336_gensoku_deceleration⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The economies of developed nations are slowing down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先進的|せんしんてき}→先進的：20024_senshinteki⟧な⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}した→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{先進|せんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たして→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧きた。
examples.english: Japan has played a leading role in this field.

notes:
Composed of {先|せん} (ahead, prior) + {進|しん} (advance, progress). Most frequently appears in the compound ⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧ (developed/advanced nation), one of the most common political and economic terms in Japanese. The opposite is {後進|こうしん} (underdeveloped) or {途上|とじょう} (developing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧: developed/advanced nation
- ⟦{先進的|せんしんてき}→先進的：20024_senshinteki⟧: advanced, pioneering (adjective)
- {先進|せんしん}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: advanced technology
- {先進|せんしん}⟦{事例|じれい}→事例：11417_jirei⟧: advanced case study, leading example
- G7⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧: the G7 advanced nations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最先端|さいせんたん}→最先端：13011_saisentan⟧: cutting-edge — the very latest, most advanced
- ⟦{先端|せんたん}→先端：04370_sentan⟧: leading edge — at the forefront of development
- {後進|こうしん}: underdeveloped — the opposite; lagging behind
- {発展途上|はってんとじょう}: developing — nations or areas still developing
